says: Two clips came with comments, and they show both moods. Under the "exosomes replaced my routine" video, commenters object that human exosomes come from placentas without consent and warn that they are unregulated and may raise cancer risk, while a few recommend Korean exosome lines. Under a man getting salmon DNA injected in Korea, viewers are shocked and grossed out, joke about fertilizing, and some admit he is glowing. The run 1 questions point the same way: "So LED masks and collagen tablets aren't worth it?!" and "Okay but what about collagen powder?". People want to know which of these is real.
